name: Ramen
description: A warming bowl of Japanese-inspired ramen, with springy noodles, a savory broth, and colorful toppings. Comfort food for slow afternoons and cozy evenings.
steps: Simmer your favorite vegetable broth with garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Boil an egg to your liking.
Pour the broth over the noodles. Add the egg, vegetables, and your favorite toppings.

name: Pancakes
description: A fluffy stack of golden pancakes makes any morning feel a little more special. Finish with fresh berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.
steps: Whisk 1 cup flour, 1 tablespoon sugar, and 1 teaspoon baking powder.
Stir in 1 egg, ¾ cup milk, and 1 tablespoon melted butter.
Spoon into a warm buttered pan. Flip when bubbles form, then serve with berries.

name: Rainbow salad
description: Fresh, crunchy, and full of color. This easy vegetable bowl brings a bright little break to your day with a zesty sesame dressing.
steps: Wash and chop the lettuce, cucumber, carrot, and avocado.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil and a little sesame oil.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and serve right away.

name: French toast
description: Crisp edges, a soft middle, and a touch of sweetness. A simple French toast recipe for the kind of breakfast you want to linger over.
steps: Whisk 2 eggs with ½ cup milk and a pinch of cinnamon.
Dip thick slices of bread into the mixture on both sides.
Cook in a buttered pan until golden on each side. Finish with honey.
